title: Suggestion sandbox and policy gate for gradual batching rollouts
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Implement a hardened sandbox + policy gating layer for applying Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) automatically. The goal is to let Optimize propose delta configs that can be auto-applied behind a controlled funnel: first dry-run in a sandbox with traffic simulation and validators, then gated canary ramps with telemetry thresholds and operator approval hooks, and finally safe automatic rollback triggers. This work bundles a sandbox execution environment, a declarative policy engine for gating, a canary ramp controller, and the audit/ops surface (telemetry & runbook) needed for safe auto-applications.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox environment accepts Optimize suggestions and runs a dry-run apply without affecting production traffic
Dry-run produces cost/latency/quality deltas on synthetic and sampled historical requests with confidence bounds
Policy engine supports rule types: latency-SLO, error-rate delta, quality-regression (LLM eval metric), and cost-per-token improvements
Canary controller can deploy a suggested config to a subset of traffic (configurable % buckets) and ramp/rollback based on policy signals
Operator approval step is optional and configurable per workspace/team via project-level policy
Automatic rollback executes within defined SLA when thresholds are breached and records the decision in audit logs
Comprehensive runbook and console UI surfaces exist for review, manual abort, and forensic analysis
End-to-end tests and a chaos-style fault test validate rollback logic for at least two failure modes
tasks: Design sandbox API contract and isolation model (requests, KV cache, and metrics sampling)
Extend Optimize suggestions payload to include sandbox metadata and suggested canary parameters
Implement sandbox runner as a containerized dry-run path that proxies model runtime with prefix/KV caching disabled/enabled variants
Build a lightweight traffic simulator using historical request replays and a synthetic generator for edge cases
Ship a policy rules engine (DSL) storing rules in project config with evaluation hooks to telemetry
Implement canary ramp controller with backoff and automatic rollback triggers tied to policy outcomes
Exposed operator UI: approve/reject, view sandbox report, configure canary %, and force rollback
Telemetry: add focused traces, percentiles, and alertable metrics for latency, token cost, error spikes, and eval-score regressions
Author runbook and test scenarios; add end-to-end integration tests and chaos rollback tests
Docs: quickstart for PMs/SREs and API docs for Optimize integration
risks: False positives from synthetic traffic might block benign improvements
Rollback latency could be high for long-lived batches or multi-stage KV cache changes
Complexity in mapping eval/quality metrics to production-level user-facing regressions
Policy misconfiguration by teams could either over-block or under-block auto-applies
Sandbox divergence from production (env differences) may produce misleading deltas
notes: Prefer additive sandbox that does not mutate customer model state; use read-only caches and simulated writes
We should reuse existing telemetry hooks in runtime-telemetry to avoid duplicating span instrumentation
Policy DSL should be simple at first (thresholds with aggregation windows) and extended later with composite rules
Coordinate with Console team to reserve UI real-estate for sandbox reports and action buttons
Plan staged rollout: internal canary (eng only) -> selected customers (opt-in) -> general availability
